self_assessment_core: Does content provide original information, reporting, research, or analysis?
Does content provide substantial, complete, comprehensive description of topic?
Does content provide insightful analysis beyond the obvious?
Is this content you'd bookmark, share with friend, or recommend?
Would you expect to see this in printed magazine, encyclopedia, or book?
Does content provide substantial value compared to other search results?
people_first_indicators: Do you have existing audience that would find content useful if they came directly?
Does content clearly demonstrate first-hand expertise and depth of knowledge?
Does your site have primary purpose or focus?
After reading, will someone feel they've learned enough to achieve their goal?
Will someone reading content leave feeling satisfied?
search_engine_first_warnings: Is content primarily made to attract visits from search engines?
Are you producing lots of content on many topics hoping some might perform well?
Are you mainly summarising what others say without adding value?
Are you writing about trending topics without real expertise?
Does content leave readers needing to search again for better information?

who_how_why_framework.who: Is it self-evident who authored content? Do pages carry bylines where expected?
who_how_why_framework.how: Are you providing background about how content was created? Is methodology transparent?
who_how_why_framework.why: Is content created primarily to help people rather than manipulate rankings?

expertise_indicators: Technical accuracy and depth of knowledge
authoritativeness_indicators: Recognition as trusted source in field

ymyl_categories.health_safety: Medical advice, safety information, dangerous activities, wellbeing topics
ymyl_categories.financial_security: Investment advice, tax guidance, major financial decisions, money management
ymyl_categories.society_civics: Government information, law, civic engagement, social issues
ymyl_categories.other_welfare: Content affecting people's welfare, wellbeing, or life decisions

quality_rating_framework.lowest: No beneficial purpose, harmful, untrustworthy, extremely poor E-E-A-T
quality_rating_framework.low: Limited value, lacking E-E-A-T, poor user experience, thin content
quality_rating_framework.medium: Adequate E-E-A-T, satisfactory user experience, acceptable quality
quality_rating_framework.high: High E-E-A-T, comprehensive user satisfaction, valuable content
quality_rating_framework.highest: Exceptional E-E-A-T, perfect user need satisfaction, outstanding quality
